headline: AI Mode now ends some answers with bigger article links
dek: Google's "Dive deeper" links, announced in October, are now showing in AI Mode, according to sightings by Glenn Gabe and Barry Schwartz over the weekend of November 21. The links sit at the end of some AI responses with image thumbnails and a more clickable design. Google has not shared how widely it is rolling out.
why: This is one of the few places in AI Mode built to send people to a site, though readers have to scroll past the full AI answer to reach it. Nobody has published click data on it yet.
doThis: Search AI Mode for two or three questions your best articles answer and check whether your pages appear under Dive deeper. If one does, make sure its featured image is clear at thumbnail size.
